question: Should Control UI Usage ship side-by-side selected-range/Today/7-day/30-day/90-day cost windows and daily chart scale labels now, once the branch is rebased and visibly proven?
rationale: The implementation is a new operator-facing feature tied to a protected maintainer-labeled request, and the current PR also needs a human-owned rebase/proof step before merge.

options.title: Land After Rebase And Proof
options.body: Accept the UI-only direction, resolve current i18n conflicts, attach visual proof, and land after normal review gates pass.

options.title: Defer To Usage Redesign
options.body: Keep the linked feature request open and pause this PR until maintainers decide the broader Usage dashboard information architecture.

options.title: Decline This Surface
options.body: Close the PR and linked request if maintainers decide existing date presets and hover details are sufficient for current workflows.
